source_championship.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("category_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "category_id"

source_phase.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("championship_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "championship_id"

source_game.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("phase_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "phase_id", CAST("home_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "home_id", CAST("away_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "away_id", CASE home_field WHEN 'left' THEN 0 WHEN 'neutral' THEN 1 WHEN 'right' THEN 2 ELSE ('invalid home_field: ' || home_field)::integer END AS "home_field", CAST("home_score" AS INTEGER) AS "home_score", CAST("away_score" AS INTEGER) AS "away_score", CAST("home_aet" AS INTEGER) AS "home_aet", CAST("away_aet" AS INTEGER) AS "away_aet", CAST("played" AS BOOLEAN) AS "played", coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP) AS "utc", (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP))::double precision)::bigint AS "moment", to_char(coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "date"

games.partitionQuery: SELECT CAST('' AS VARCHAR) AS __partition,r.* FROM result_games r

teams.partitionQuery: SELECT CAST('' AS VARCHAR) AS __partition,r.* FROM result_teams r

source_championship.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("category_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "category_id" FROM "championship"

source_phase.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("championship_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "championship_id" FROM "phase"

source_game.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("phase_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "phase_id", CAST("home_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "home_id", CAST("away_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "away_id", CASE home_field WHEN 'left' THEN 0 WHEN 'neutral' THEN 1 WHEN 'right' THEN 2 ELSE error('home_field ' || home_field) END AS "home_field", CAST("home_score" AS INTEGER) AS "home_score", CAST("away_score" AS INTEGER) AS "away_score", CAST("home_aet" AS INTEGER) AS "home_aet", CAST("away_aet" AS INTEGER) AS "away_aet", CAST("played" AS BOOLEAN) AS "played", strftime(coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS "utc", epoch(coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP))::BIGINT AS "moment", strftime(coalesce(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', day::DATE::TIMESTAMP), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') AS "date" FROM "game"

source_team.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id" FROM "team"
